evals.prompt: Ich hab ein DE10-Lite Board (Cyclone 10 LP, 50 MHz, 3,3 V). Bau mir ein Quartus-Projekt mit einem 7-Segment-Zaehler in Verilog - inkl. .qsf, .sdc und Testbench.

assertions.name: liefert-verilog-source
assertions.text: Answer includes a Verilog/SystemVerilog module definition (module ... endmodule) for the counter/7-segment design.

assertions.name: liefert-qsf-assignments
assertions.text: Answer includes .qsf assignments with set_global_assignment and TOP_LEVEL_ENTITY.

assertions.name: liefert-sdc-clock
assertions.text: Answer includes an SDC timing constraint with create_clock.

assertions.name: liefert-testbench
assertions.text: Answer includes a testbench that drives the clock and/or reset (initial/timescale/#delay).

assertions.name: beachtet-board
assertions.text: Answer accounts for the actual DE10-Lite board context (MAX 10 / Cyclone 10 LP / 10M50 / 50 MHz) rather than using a generic different device.

evals.prompt: Mein Projekt wirft negative Slack auf 50 MHz und mein .sdc hat nur create_clock. Was muss ich aendern?

assertions.name: constraints-vervollstaendigen
assertions.text: Answer says to complete the .sdc beyond create_clock and mentions derive_pll_clocks / derive_clock_uncertainty / set_clock_groups / false_path / multicycle at least one.

assertions.name: io-delays
assertions.text: Answer mentions set_input_delay / set_output_delay for I/O constraints.

assertions.name: erst-report-dann-rtl
assertions.text: Answer advises to inspect report_timing and confirm the real path before rewriting RTL.

assertions.name: rtl-fixes
assertions.text: Answer suggests RTL/timing-closure fixes: pipeline / register retiming / reduce logic depth / clock enable.

evals.prompt: Ich will OpenCL auf meinem DE1-SoC (Cyclone V) mit Quartus 17.1 nutzen. Welche aoc/aocl-Versionen und BSP brauch ich, und wie laeuft der Kernel-Compile?

assertions.name: version-lock-171
assertions.text: Answer states the FPGA SDK for OpenCL must match Quartus (17.1 for 17.1).

assertions.name: bsp-separat
assertions.text: Answer explains the BSP is per-board and downloaded separately (Terasic) for the DE1-SoC.

assertions.name: aoc-aoclx-flow
assertions.text: Answer explains aoc compile (.cl to .aocx) and aocl program/install runtime.

assertions.name: lizenz-171
assertions.text: Answer notes the separate OpenCL SDK license was removed in 17.1 (free/bundled; LM_LICENSE_FILE only pre-17.1).

evals.prompt: Ich migriere einen VHDL-Entwurf von Xilinx nach Intel. Wo liegen die Unterschiede?

assertions.name: projekt-dateiformate
assertions.text: Answer contrasts Quartus .qsf/.qpf with Vivado .xpr/.xdc project files.

assertions.name: vendor-bibliotheken
assertions.text: Answer explains UNISIM/Xilinx primitives map to Intel alternatives (altpll, altsyncram, altera_mf, lpm).

assertions.name: ip-nicht-portierbar
assertions.text: Answer notes IP cores (.xci vs .qip/Platform Designer) are not portable and must be regenerated.

assertions.name: sdc-timing
assertions.text: Answer notes SDC timing is largely portable / uses create_clock, delays, false/multicycle paths.
